Contact Graduate Admissions
Several of our graduate programs do not require test scores for admissions consideration. Here you can view which programs will require a GRE or GMAT test score for graduate admissions consideration.
If your program requires a test score, as strong candidate for graduate admission typically has:
A minimum total score of 300 on the GRE and a minimum score of 3.0 on the analytical writing portion
A minimum total score of 500 on the GMAT
Please note, department standards may be higher, so these minimum scores do not guarantee admission to the UAH Graduate School. For more information regarding specific admissions requirements to your program of interest, contact your program coordinator. Please also note that while the requirement for GRE or GMAT scores may be waived, this does not exempt international applicants from the university-wide requirement of demonstrating English language proficiency.
